title: Kahana’s AI assistant
description: The beta chatbot in the bottom-right of the app. It answers how-to questions and can prepare hubs, clubs, profile updates, and affiliate links. Nothing is written until you confirm.
content:
Kahana’s AI assistant is in beta. It sits in the bottom-right corner of the app, with a phoenix glowing around the chatbot. Ask how something works, or ask it to prepare a change. It does not save that change until you confirm the card.

Primary action: Open Kahana, then use the glowing chatbot in the bottom-right.

What you can ask

  • How do I… gets a short step-by-step answer from Kahana’s help, not a save card.
  • Create or update something gets a confirm card. Examples: a hub, a club, a profile text update, setup goals, For You weights, or a hub affiliate link.
  • Type @ to point at a hub, club, or file you already have.
  • The paperclip attaches files when you are asking to upload into a hub or set a cover or profile photo.

Confirm before anything is saved

A card such as Create hub or Save affiliate link is a proposal. Read the title, price, or visibility on the card, then tap the button. If you close the chat without confirming, nothing was written.

Affiliate links saved from the assistant follow the same rule as My affiliates: a free account keeps a draft. Growth is what makes an enabled link live.

Train a reply

Thumbs up on a message opens Train Kahana assistant with Good response selected. Thumbs down opens it with Bad response. Choose a category, what stood out, and write at least 30 characters. Personalized keeps the feedback tied to you. Anonymous still sends the note for product improvement, without your user ID on the training record. Submit does not write hubs, clubs, or affiliate links. Those still need a confirm card.

Feedback and support

In the assistant header, Feedback is the message icon. Use it when an answer was useful or off. Support is the question mark, for a ticket. Chat history is the list icon, if you want an older thread.

What’s next

  • Open Kahana
  • Hubs
  • Affiliate links for your hubs
  • Blog: the assistant in beta
